svg.text: Does the evidence chain verify, and does its anchor agree with

node -e const fs=require('fs'),c=require('crypto');const L=fs.readFileSync('evidence/control_plane/ledger.ndjson','utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).map(JSON.parse);let broken=0,prev=null;for(const e of L){ if(prev&&e.prev_hash!==prev) broken++; prev=e.hash; }const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('evidence/control_plane/anchor.json','utf8'));console.log('entries='+L.length);console.log('broken_links='+broken);console.log('anchor_length='+a.length+' anchor_head='+String(a.head).slice(0,16)+'...');console.log('tip_hash='+String(L[L.length-1].hash).slice(0,16)+'...');console.log('anchor_agrees='+(a.length===L.length&&a.head===L[L.length-1].hash));
evidence/control_plane/ledger.ndjson and anchor.json — each entry naming the hash of the entry before it
